current_facts: 500 MB database; 1 GB file storage; 5 GB egress and cached egress; two active projects; projects may pause after one week of low activity
principal_implication: Useful for prototypes but cannot guarantee unattended availability or long-lived version retention
limitation: Quotas and policy can change; integrated platform coupling remains

current_facts: From USD 25/month; first project included; 8 GB database disk; 100 GB file storage; 250 GB egress; daily backups retained 7 days
principal_implication: Removes inactivity pausing and may be adequate for a first connected deployment
limitation: Still provider-specific and database/storage growth must be measured

current_facts: Low-activity Free projects may pause after a seven-day window; restoration is available for up to one year
principal_implication: Free tier is not a durable always-on guarantee
limitation: Restoration still requires owner intervention and has a time window

current_facts: Free includes 1 GB; Pro includes 100 GB; paid overage is USD 0.0213 per GB-month
principal_implication: Paid object storage is inexpensive relative to database storage and supports keeping payloads outside relational rows
limitation: Does not by itself provide provider-neutral artifact semantics

current_facts: 10 GB-month free; 1 million Class A and 10 million Class B operations free monthly; Standard storage USD 0.015 per GB-month; no R2 egress charge
principal_implication: Strong candidate for immutable JSON/assets with S3-compatible access and low storage cost
limitation: Object storage only; auth, metadata, transactions and policy require other components

current_facts: Supports Workers API, S3-compatible APIs, CLI and dashboard
principal_implication: Could implement a provider-neutral ArtifactRepository adapter
limitation: Requires account billing setup and careful operation-count modelling

current_facts: SQLite semantics; Free includes 5 GB total storage, 5 million rows read/day and 100,000 rows written/day; paid bills rows and storage
principal_implication: Could support small metadata deployments with scale-to-zero and no egress fees
limitation: SQLite semantics and row-based billing need workload validation against ARA relations and policies

current_facts: 0.5 GB storage per project; 100 CU-hours monthly per project; scale-to-zero after inactivity; short restore window
principal_implication: Provides many small Postgres projects and avoids permanent compute cost while inactive
limitation: Not a complete BaaS/object storage solution; free storage remains small

current_facts: Usage-based; USD 0.106 per CU-hour and USD 0.35 per GB-month; up to seven-day restore window
principal_implication: Candidate for portable managed Postgres when auth/object storage are separate
limitation: Cost is more variable and database storage is much more expensive than object storage

current_facts: 2 GB storage; one database, one bucket and two functions per project; pauses after one week of inactivity
principal_implication: Integrated alternative with more free object storage than Supabase
limitation: Free limitations and pausing remain; database model requires validation

current_facts: From USD 25/month; 150 GB storage; unlimited databases, buckets and functions; seven-day daily backups
principal_implication: Paid integrated alternative with substantial included storage
limitation: Migration from PostgreSQL/RLS and operational semantics would be substantial
